newsitem.title: USA: TFC unit gets new $150 mln credit facility.
newsitem.headline: TFC unit gets new $150 mln credit facility.

text.p: TFC Enterprises Inc said Thursday that its subsidiary, The Finance Co, has an agreement to extend its credit facility for a $150 million line with its primary lender, General Electric Capital Corp.
The agreement runs through December 31, 1998. TFC said it is currently using about $74 million of this facility.

TFC said the agreement also gives General Electric Capital, a unit of General Electric Co, warrants to buy about 560,000 shares of TFC common stock at $2 per share over a four years. The company said the sum represents about 5 percent of its outstanding shares.
"This will provide the funding that gives the company the opportunity to achieve its business plan for 1997 and 1998," TFC said in a release.
The Finance Co buys and services installment sales contracts by automobile and motorcycle dealers.
